Tips Originals Presents Kumar Taurani's Latest Hindi New Romantic Love Song "Jab Tum Samne The" featuring Ashish Bisht and Malvi Malhotra. Sung by Dev Negi and composed by Shamir Tandon, with lyrics penned by Kumaar.
Song Details :
Song Name : Jab Tum Samne The
Star Cast : Ashish Bisht, Malvi Malhotra
Singer: Dev Negi
Directed By Video Brains
Producer: Kumar Taurani
Music Director: Shamir Tandon
